criteria.description: One flexible top media region, one cover video, one scrim, one motion control, one bottom band, one h1, one description, and exactly two CTA destinations exist with no excluded parts
Mobile stacks heading then description/actions; desktop uses two equal top-aligned columns
Section fills 100svh, top video consumes remaining height, media and scrim cover it, and the page does not overflow
Video autoplays when allowed, pause/play works, reduced motion starts paused, and native controls survive without JavaScript
Both CTA anchors resolve and remain usable with JavaScript disabled
Semantic order, visible focus, 44px targets, playsinline, themes, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Uses documented layouts/tokens with no framework, placeholder URL, primitive palette, hardcoded color, raw reduced-motion patch, or copied-source leakage
Fresh desktop, seam, mobile, dark, paused, reduced-motion, and JavaScript-disabled captures are inspected before green evidence
